channel.name: Pop Culture Lore & Evolution
channel.niche: Pop Culture Lore, Timelines, and Character Evolutions
channel.target_audience: Dedicated fanbases of major franchises (e.g., Minecraft, Marvel, GTA, Star Wars, Dragon Ball)
channel.core_value: Providing the ultimate, definitive deep-dive that saves viewers from researching complex storylines themselves.
channel.monetization: High Watch Time for YPP qualification, then AdSense via strategic mid-roll ad placement

kpis.thumbnail_concept: High-contrast character-driven; show a clear Before vs After or Level 1 vs Level 100 visual dynamic

timeline.name: The Complete Timeline (Lore Explainer)
timeline.description: Chronological breakdown of a massive franchise or universe
timeline.example: The Entire 20-Year Timeline of World of Warcraft Explained

character_evolution.name: Character Evolution (Before & After)
character_evolution.description: Tracking the physical, psychological, and lore-based changes of an iconic character over decades
character_evolution.title_formula: The Full Evolution of {Character}: {StartYear} to Present
character_evolution.example: The Full Evolution of Kratos: 2005 to Present

animated_summary.name: Animated Summary
animated_summary.description: Compressing massive book series, complex movie universes, or long game plots into one seamless animated long-form documentary
animated_summary.title_formula: The Entire History of {Universe}, Every Detail Explained
animated_summary.example: The Entire History of the Marvel Universe, Every Detail Explained

hook.rule: State the ultimate mystery or epic scale of the video in the first 30 seconds. No slow intros.

scripting_rules.retention_spike: Insert a dramatic question, a plot twist, or a 'Did you know?' fact at the END of every chapter to prevent viewers from clicking away.
scripting_rules.structure: 0:00–0:30 = Hook, then divide into chronological chapters every 5–8 minutes
scripting_rules.narration_style: Cinematic, deep, and engaging. Warm and direct — the viewer is a dedicated fan.

visual_rules.animation_technique: Movement via panning, zooming, and character sliding. Avoid frame-by-frame lip-syncing.
visual_rules.note: Reusable modular asset library to support 30–60 minute runtime efficiently.

title_formulas: The Entire History of {Universe}, Every Detail Explained
The Full Evolution of {Character}: {StartYear} to Present

shorts_extraction.criteria: High-intensity moments: major revelations, shocking plot twists, dramatic character transformations
shorts_extraction.cta: Pinned comment linking back to the full video
